tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt round 2, slice 1 — runtime i18n + accessibility. BUG1 proved key PARITY statically (607/607 keys); it did NOT prove the APPLY path works at runtime.

VERIFIED RECIPE (works): serve editor `python3 -m http.server 18046 -d apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg &`; playwright via require('/home/weiss/git/World-Office/wo-test-harness/census/node_modules/playwright'); goto domcontentloaded + sleep 2500.

KNOWN CONTEXT:
- apply-i18n runs at boot; locale switch exists (grep the language/theme switch — Interface theme / Language options / backstage Settings; probe how a locale change re-applies strings).
- BUG1 registered ALL 42 dialog-overlay ids in DIALOG_IDS (modal Tab trap) — but some overlays may be NON-modal by design (comment popover? anchored popovers were excluded). A wrongly-trapped non-modal overlay breaks tabbing out. AUDIT this.
- aria-pressed is toggled by command handlers; state can also change via OTHER paths (ctx menu doing the same op, keyboard shortcut, dialog applying the same property). Stuck/wrongly-lit buttons = real bug class.

YOUR DELIVERABLES (fix everything found):
1. scripts/locale-a11y.mjs (live probe, BUG2 style): boot in en, snapshot every visible user-facing string source (ribbon buttons' text/title/aria-label, menu rows, dialogs' static labels after opening each, statusbar, backstage rows); switch locale to de via the REAL UI path; snapshot again; assert ZERO English leftovers in de (excluding document content, proper nouns like 'DOCX', numeric/symbol-only). Switch back to en; assert clean. Also assert document content is NOT re-translated (sample text untouched).
2. Focus-trap audit in the same probe: while each dialog-overlay is open, Tab cycles INSIDE it (BUG1 behavior); while NON-modal surfaces are shown (ctx menu, anchored insert popovers, styles menu, File menu), Tab must NOT be hijacked as if a modal were open — verify getOpenDialog() returns null for them. Fix wrongly-registered non-modals (move out of DIALOG_IDS + document why, comment style ~1776).
3. aria-pressed sync: build a matrix probe — toggle a state via ribbon button (bold, align left/center/right/justify, RTL, track changes, spellcheck on, ruler, gridlines, ruler/formatting marks, theme), then change the SAME state via another path (ctx menu row / keyboard shortcut / view menu / settings dialog), assert the ribbon button's aria-pressed follows. Fix desyncs at the single source of truth (state-setter function updates the button, not each caller).
4. locale-a11y.test.mjs gate: static pins (locale switch function exists and is called by the language control; state-setter centralization asserts for the fixed desyncs; script exists). ALL *.test.mjs green (29 files after this).
5. Commit: 'fix(BUG4-LOCALE-A11Y): runtime locale apply, focus-trap non-modals, aria-pressed sync' + body with findings table.

tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt round 2, slice 2 — multi-step flows BUG2 deliberately skipped (it only pressed safe primaries).

VERIFIED RECIPE: http.server port 18047, playwright absolute-require from wo-test-harness/census/node_modules, domcontentloaded + 2500ms. Stub window.fetch BEFORE load (addInitScript) to capture /api/documents calls and return controlled JSON — the bridge POSTs {html} on save; export paths may fetch too; probe exact endpoints in wo-bridge.js first.

YOUR DELIVERABLES (fix everything found):
1. scripts/deep-flows.mjs driving each flow end-to-end, asserting OUTCOMES not just absence-of-errors:
   a. Find/replace: seed text with 3 matches (2 exact + 1 case-different); find next cycles; match-case toggle changes match count; replace one; replace-all count correct; no match -> no-op + status feedback; find with regex-special chars (.*[]) literal-safe.
   b. Version history: open, assert revisions listed, rollback to earlier revision restores previous content exactly, rollback is itself undoable or clearly committed (match existing semantics — probe).
   c. Comment lifecycle: add comment on selection (ctx + Insert tab), reply, resolve (comment span state changes), delete via collab tab; each step updates the comment model (data-replies/data-resolved) and the marker in text; deleting a comment with replies — probe semantics, must not corrupt the doc.
   d. Track changes: enable, type (insertion tracked), delete (deletion tracked), accept insertion (becomes plain), reject deletion (text restored), next/prev navigate, disable stops tracking. Content must end correct.
   e. Zoom: 100 -> 125 -> 100 via buttons AND Ctrl+wheel AND Ctrl+0 reset; zoom label stays in sync; fit-page/fit-width set a zoom state.
   f. Save/export via fetch stub: Save fires POST with current clean HTML (spell markers absent per BUG3); Export DOCX/ODT/HTML/PDF each fire their endpoint (or marker if backend-gated); no duplicate POSTs.
   g. Keyboard sweep: every aria-keyshortcuts on the page — fire the real combo, assert the effect equals clicking the button (compare DOM/aria-pressed); assert no combo double-applies (listen for doubled markers).
2. Triage table in the commit body: real bug (fixed) / by-design / harness artifact. Known-suspect: shortcut handling vs browser defaults (Ctrl+P, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+F must preventDefault if claimed), find dialog open state vs replace focus, comment model JSON in data-replies after multiple replies.
3. deep-flows-gate.test.mjs: thin static gate (script exists + key flow selectors referenced). ALL *.test.mjs green (30 files).
4. Commit: 'fix(BUG5-DEEP-FLOWS): flow outcome fixes from end-to-end probes' + body.

tasks.accept: cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && for t in *.test.mjs; do node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt round 2, slice 3 — hostile/edge conditions. Every system survives the happy path; bugs live at the edges.

VERIFIED RECIPE: http.server port 18048, playwright absolute-require from harness node_modules, domcontentloaded + 2500ms. addInitScript for pre-load state poisoning (localStorage writes before app boots) and fetch/abort stubbing.

YOUR DELIVERABLES (fix everything found):
1. scripts/edge.mjs scenarios, each asserting graceful behavior (no unhandled rejection, no dead UI, no data loss):
   a. POISONED STORAGE: localStorage 'wo-user-dict' = '[object Object]', '{broken json', '999999' entries-ish huge string, null; 'wo-settings' (probe real key) = bad JSON; app must boot, not throw, not wipe other keys, spellcheck still works.
   b. OFFLINE: fetch stub rejects (TypeError) BEFORE any call — Save, Open, Export, version list: each must surface an error state (status toast/dialog/message), not spin forever, not throw unhandled. Re-enable and Save again must work.
   c. EMPTY DOC: fresh boot, run EVERY ribbon data-cmd (BUG2 census list) on the empty doc: no pageerror, undo stack only gains entries for real changes (no phantom entries — BUG2 found this class).
   d. HUGE DOC: seed 3000 paragraphs; measure: full spellcheck run < 5s, save serialization < 2s, word count < 500ms, one format op < 1s (performance.now marks; note numbers in report).
   e. RAPID FIRE: 50 alternating tab switches; open/close the same dialog 20x fast; toggle spellcheck on/off 10x during active typing; ctx menu spam. No leaked listeners (count keydown listeners via getEventListeners if available, else behavior check), no ghost overlays left open, memory sane (performance.memory delta noted).
   f. PASTE: paste HTML containing <script>, onerror= attr, <style>, <iframe>, inline style with position:fixed, huge base64 img — paste path must sanitize (probe how paste is handled; if it uses flatHtml allowlist, verify) — document survives, no script executes (assert no window.__pwned marker via a planted setter).
   g. THEME/DARK: switch interface theme dark + dark document mid-session with a doc containing tables/charts/comments; no invisible text (computed contrast check on a few elements), no broken overlays.
2. Triage table; fix all real bugs at root cause. Known-suspect: localStorage parse without try/catch anywhere it's read (grep JSON.parse), unbounded userDict growth, spellcheck full-scan on huge doc (AF11 sampling note), paste using innerHTML directly anywhere.
3. edge-gate.test.mjs thin static gate. ALL *.test.mjs green (31 files).
4. Commit: 'fix(BUG6-EDGE-ROBUSTNESS): storage poisoning, offline errors, perf, paste sanitizer, theme' + body.
